tools.name: biliscript_transcribe
tools.description: Queue a bilibili video for transcription into a dialogue script with speakers separated. Returns the job number at once; the result arrives later as a biliscript.finished or biliscript.failed event.

video.description: BV id, av id, video page URL or b23.tv short link.

page.description: Part number of a multi-part video. Default: the p in the URL, else 1.

speakers.description: Exact number of speakers, when known. Improves separation.

summary.zh: 把一个 B 站视频的对话转写成区分说话人的剧本,在后台排队进行。
summary.en: Transcribes the dialogue of a bilibili video into a script with speakers separated, queued in the background.

tools.name: biliscript_jobs
tools.description: List transcription jobs with their state, stage and progress, newest first.

summary.zh: 列出转写任务的状态与进度。
summary.en: Lists transcription jobs with state and progress.

tools.name: biliscript_read
tools.description: Read lines of a finished script as "[time] Name: line", with the cast and its line counts.

speaker.description: Only lines of this label (S1, S2, ...).

summary.en: Reads script lines page by page.

tools.name: biliscript_name_speakers
tools.description: Give speaker labels character names and rewrite the script file. An empty string returns a label to unnamed. Labels not listed keep their names.

summary.zh: 给说话人标签起人物名并重写剧本文件。
summary.en: Gives speaker labels character names and rewrites the script file.

tools.name: biliscript_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job.

summary.zh: 取消排队中或进行中的任务。
summary.en: Cancels a queued or running job.

description.zh: 一个转写任务完成,附人物表与开头几句。
description.en: A transcription job finished, with the cast and the opening lines.

description.zh: 一个转写任务失败,附失败阶段与原因。
description.en: A transcription job failed, with the stage and the reason.

prompts.title: B 站对话剧本 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
## Bilibili dialogue scripts

You can turn the dialogue of a bilibili video into a script: `biliscript_transcribe` downloads the video's audio, recognizes the speech with Whisper, separates speakers by voice, and writes the lines as a script file in the form "[time] Character: line". A video takes minutes to tens of minutes, and jobs run one at a time in order; you do not need to wait after the call: `biliscript.finished` arrives when a job completes, `biliscript.failed` if it fails. `biliscript_jobs` shows progress.

Speaker separation clusters voices only: the labels S1, S2, ... are numbered by first appearance and say nothing about who is who; now and then one person is split into two labels, or two similar voices are merged into one. {{biliscript.writer}} To name them, read the lines with `biliscript_read`, judge from forms of address, self-introductions, mentions in the dialogue and the video title, then write the names into the script with `biliscript_name_speakers`; a speaker with no evidence keeps its label, and names are never invented.

Recognized text can contain homophone errors, especially in names and terms; keep that in mind when quoting lines.

Current environment: {{biliscript.setup}}
